name: AWS Regions
description: What an AWS Region is, how Regions are isolated from each other, which services are regional versus global, and how to choose a Region on compliance, latency, service availability and cost.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Can say that a Region is a geographic cluster of data centres with a code like ap-south-1.
Can pick a Region for a workload and justify it on compliance, latency, service availability and cost, in that order.
indicators: Knows Regions are independent of each other.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Has deployed to more than one Region and dealt with a service or quota missing in one of them.
Designs multi-Region active/active or DR topologies with explicit RTO/RPO reasoning.
